setup.laterHint: You can change all of this later

join.title: Fill in your details
join.subtitle: So {library} can add you to their records. Takes a minute.
join.name: Your full name
join.shift: Which shift do you come in?
join.seat: Your seat number (if you know it)
join.lastPaid: When did you last pay fees?
join.lastPaidHint: Leave empty if you don't remember
join.tooMany: This number has sent too many times. Try tomorrow or talk to the library.
join.failed: Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again.

join.badLinkBody: Ask the library for a new QR code or link.
join.privacy: Only the library can see your details.

joinShare.title: Students fill in their details

joinShare.linkHint: Put up the QR or send the link — they fill it, you confirm

joinShare.posterBody: Scan this QR with your phone camera
joinShare.shareText: Hi! Please fill in your details for {library} here (1 minute): {link}
joinShare.resetHint: The old QR and link will stop working. Only do this if the wrong people are using the link.
joinShare.resetDone: New link ready. Print the new poster.
